name: Good Morning Is A Social Construct
source:
follow 15 year old miya nakamina's daily life in high school, where she finds herself increasingly lost and alien. her only friend is growing up past her own pace, where does that leave miya in the world? completely alone forever, probably...

[From [url=https://malaises.itch.io/gm]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟随15岁少女仲皆美夜的高中日常生活，看她在校园里如何日渐迷茫、愈发感到格格不入。她唯一的朋友正以远超她步伐的速度不断成长，而这又把美夜留在了世界的哪个角落呢？大概，是永远孤身一人吧……

[摘自[url=https://malaises.itch.io/gm]itch.io[/url]]
